positions.title: Computational Scientist
positions.locationName: U.S. Army Research Laboratory | Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland
positions.description:
I write and optimize brilliantly high performance software for computer architectures and HPC clusters which include, but are not limited to Intel and AMD x86 multi-core CPUs, the Intel Xeon Phi, Nvidia and AMD GPUs, low-power ARM CPUs, and energy-efficient Adapteva Epiphany RISC arrays.

Originally, I joined HPTi in 2008, which was subsequently bought out by DRC and then subsequently bought by Engility Corporation.  My seat and most of my great colleagues haven't changed in that time.
